blind.description: A medieval-style wrought iron ring chandelier sitting flat on the floor. It consists of an outer circular iron ring and an inner concentric ring connected by radial spokes to a central hub. Around both rings are mounted small metal cups holding short, unlit yellowish wax candles. Three heavy link chains extend upwards from the outer ring/spokes to converge at a central top suspension ring. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with no holes, shards, or floating geometry. Materials are dark grey wrought iron/metal and pale yellow wax candles with small wicks (no flames or active glow).
blind.from_above: Two concentric dark iron circles joined by radiating spokes like a wagon wheel, dotted symmetrically with pale circular candle tops, beneath three chains that converge into a top central suspension ring.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2.5 to 3 ft tall to the top ring) and about two-thirds as wide in diameter (around 3.5 to 4 ft wide).
